visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing denim overalls over a white tank top, stands in a brightly lit indoor space. She speaks with animated facial expressions, shifting from nervous anticipation to a slight smile. (2) A rapid series of jump cuts reveals a renovated interior with minimalist white cabinetry, a grand piano, and glowing accent lighting. The environment is clean and modern with soft shadows. (3) The screen splits: the top shows a white drawer sliding open automatically; the bottom shows the woman lying on the grey floor, sliding her body into the open cabinet space with an expression of exaggerated shock. (4) The woman is seen in a close-up, covering her mouth in surprise before turning to walk toward a doorway. (5) On the second floor, the camera pans across a wooden dining set and large white bookshelves filled with colorful books and toy robot figurines under warm indoor lighting. (6) A high-speed montage shows the woman crawling and sliding frantically across the floor, disappearing behind cabinets and under tables as if being pulled. (7) The woman is seen crouching and moving quickly under a low table in a hallway with light-colored wooden flooring. (8) Finally, the woman sits calmly in a rounded grey lounge chair, reading a white book. The lighting is soft, and a large green plant and piano are in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks in high-pitched Japanese with an anticipatory tone. No BGM is present, focusing on her vocal clarity. (2) Upbeat, fast-paced orchestral BGM featuring violins and percussive piano hits enters. The female voice transitions into a professional narrative style. (3) A sudden mechanical sliding sound occurs as a drawer opens, followed immediately by a sharp, high-pitched comedic scream from the female speaker. (4) Multiple layered cartoon-style whooshing sounds and frantic vocal growls ('Zombie sounds') overlap with the rhythmic BGM as the intensity increases. (5) A sharp percussive thud marks a shift; the female voice says a short phrase in Japanese before the BGM tempo increases again. (6) Rapid sequence of 'Aah!' screams and mechanical clicks sync with fast-paced orchestral strings, creating a sense of chaotic humor. (7) The BGM transitions to a lighter, more elegant piano melody. The female voice lowers in intensity and pitch, adopting a calm, descriptive tone until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Chaotic Demonstration -> Elegant Result
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a home/studio renovation project in a viral, comedic style. It contrasts the 'before/after' transformation with a slapstick-style performance of the homeowner reacting to the automated furniture.
